caption: This drawing, rendered in shades of gray pencil on off-white paper, depicts multiple views and detailed aspects of a lidded tankard. Dominating the lower portion of the page is a large, highly detailed tankard with a hinged lid, ornate handle, and decorative reliefs. The handle is adorned with a female face at the midpoint and ends with an elaborate base featuring a similar face motif. The bottom rim also features decorative reliefs. The lid has a raised design, and the hinge is embellished with beaded and scroll elements. In the upper left corner, a simple side profile outline of a tankard is shown. To its right, there is a circular crest that includes the letters "W.G.S." surrounded by floral designs. Near the top center is a detailed heraldic emblem with a griffin, the year "1838," and cursive writing encircling it. The monogram "Mark GK" is inscribed near the upper left of the main tankard. The overall composition combines technical illustration, artistic flourish, and calligraphy, all in monochrome pencil. The artist's name, "G. Sanborn," is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Tankard
